<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover"><title>Arjun Rose J S · Robotics &amp; Automation Engineer</title>

<script>document.documentElement.classList.add("js")</script>
<style>
:root{--bg:#f3f6fb;--fg:#0b1220;--mut:#55617c;--acc:#00a58e;--acc2:#d9780a;--card:#fff;--ln:#d8e0ee;color-scheme:light;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme=light]){--bg:#070b14;--fg:#e8eefc;--mut:#8a97b5;--acc:#22e6c9;--acc2:#ffb454;--card:#0e1526;--ln:#1d2a45;color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme=dark]{--bg:#070b14;--fg:#e8eefc;--mut:#8a97b5;--acc:#22e6c9;--acc2:#ffb454;--card:#0e1526;--ln:#1d2a45;color-scheme:dark}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font:16px/1.6 "Space Grotesk",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}
.w{max-width:1080px;margin:auto;padding:0 20px}section{padding:52px 0}
h1,h2,h3{line-height:1.15;margin:0}a{color:inherit}
h2{font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,38px);margin-bottom:26px}
h2 small{display:block;font:600 13px "JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;color:var(--acc);letter-spacing:.12em;margin-bottom:8px}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr .8fr;gap:36px;align-items:center;padding-top:48px}
h1{font-size:clamp(40px,8vw,76px);letter-spacing:-.03em;margin-top:18px}
h1 span{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--acc),var(--acc2));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.role{font:600 clamp(16px,2.6vw,22px) "JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;color:var(--acc);min-height:1.6em;margin:14px 0}
.role::after{content:"▍";animation:bl 1s steps(2) infinite}
.chip{display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--ln);background:var(--card);border-radius:99px;padding:6px 14px;font-size:14px}
.chip i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acc);animation:pu 1.8s infinite}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:11px 20px;margin:0 8px 10px 0;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--ln);background:var(--card);text-decoration:none;font:600 16px inherit;font-family:inherit;color:var(--fg);cursor:pointer;transition:.25s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--acc)}.btn.p{background:var(--acc);color:#04120f;border-color:var(--acc)}
.ph{position:relative;width:min(300px,72vw);aspect-ratio:1;justify-self:center}
.ph::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-7px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(var(--acc),var(--acc2),var(--acc));animation:sp 7s linear infinite}
.ph img{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:6px solid var(--bg);display:block}
.st{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:30px}
.st div,.card,.box{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:16px;padding:18px}
.st b{display:block;font:700 34px "JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;color:var(--acc)}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:18px}
.box p{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px;margin:10px 0 0}
canvas{width:100%;height:300px;display:block;touch-action:pan-y;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(var(--bg),var(--card))}
.lad{width:100%}.lad path,.lad circle{fill:none;stroke:var(--ln);stroke-width:2.5}
.lad .pre,.lad .on{stroke:var(--acc)}.lad .k{stroke:var(--fg)}.lad .on{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px var(--acc))}
.lad text{fill:var(--mut);font:11px "JetBrains Mono",monospace}
#coil.on{stroke-dasharray:7 5;animation:sp 1.4s linear infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
.tl{border-left:2px solid var(--ln);margin-left:6px}.it{position:relative;padding:0 0 26px 24px}
.it::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-7px;top:6px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acc);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--acc)}
.it em{font:600 12px "JetBrains Mono",monospace;color:var(--acc2);font-style:normal}.it h3{font-size:19px;margin:2px 0 4px}.it p{margin:0;color:var(--mut)}
.pg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:18px}
.card{transition:.25s}.card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--acc);box-shadow:0 10px 30px -14px var(--acc)}
.ft{grid-column:span 2}.card h3{font-size:17px}.card p{color:var(--mut);margin:8px 0 0;font-size:15px}
.tg{display:inline-block;font:12px "JetBrains Mono",monospace;border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:99px;padding:2px 10px;margin:10px 6px 0 0;color:var(--mut)}
.f button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--ln);background:var(--card);color:var(--fg);border-radius:99px;padding:6px 16px;margin:0 8px 8px 0}
.f button.on{background:var(--acc);color:#04120f;border-color:var(--acc)}
.c{display:inline-block;margin:0 8px 8px 0;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--ln);font-size:14px}
.c.a{background:var(--acc);color:#04120f;border-color:var(--acc);font-weight:600}.c.i{border-color:var(--acc)}.c.b{color:var(--mut)}
.js .rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .7s,transform .7s}.js .rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
@keyframes sp{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@keyframes bl{50%{opacity:0}}@keyframes pu{70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 9px transparent}0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 var(--acc)}}
@media(max-width:640px){.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ph{order:-1}.ft{grid-column:auto}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
